name: CropSight-US validated fields
description: 124,419 validated field polygons across CONUS, 2013-2023. Crop identity from Google Street View (97.2% accuracy); boundary delineation from Sentinel-2 (98.0% F1). 17 crop types, 294 Agricultural Statistics Districts. Ground-truth-quality where present, NOT a wall-to-wall paint layer — use as a reference to spot-check against, not as a coverage source. UIUC research; ESSD 2026 paper (Copernicus); Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19501943.
